observations.behavior: Adds a row-bound constant and documentation, while removing the byte-bound check and replacing it with a row-bound check.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent memory exhaustion by bounding the number of rows buffered before flushing, rather than just the byte size. This could help prevent OOMs when processing large tables with many small files.
